column3: CSP allows inline styles (the client styles elements from JS; no script can run from CSS) and https: images (link previews, GIFs, Battle.net art come from anywhere)
No COEP/CORP: cross-origin isolation would block Google Fonts and link-preview images; nothing here needs SharedArrayBuffer
Comments in the vendored LiveKit client and our own scripts (no secrets in a public client)
Snowflake IDs and timestamps in JSON look like Unix times; they're meant to be there
Yes, it's a modern web app
Static files are cacheable by design (Cache-Control: no-cache revalidates them)
Static files use no-cache (revalidate); API answers aren't shared caches' business behind Apache
